# `armadad doctor`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

Runs pre-flight checks on this host: the container runtime, the private IP,
ports bound publicly, file permissions in the data directory, the certificates on
this machine and in the client config (--config), the secrets tmpfs, the clock, and
the host firewall. Exits non-zero if a check fails.

```
armadad doctor [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--data-dir string` | Armada data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
| `--private-ip string` | this node's private (VPC) IP (default: the node's own, else the only private IPv4 address) |
| `--secrets-dir string` | tmpfs directory for secret files (default `/run/armada/secrets`) |
